headline.en: Atrium Launches Platform Tracking $1.3T of US Data Center Development Credit
headline.zh: Atrium 推出平台，追踪 1.3 万亿美元美国数据中心开发信贷

summary.en: Atrium, a San Diego-based AI analytics startup founded in 2024, launched an interactive data and research platform called "Who Finances America's Data Centers." The platform tracks the debt behind every US data center deal, covering $1.3 trillion of identifiable debt across nearly 4,300 domestic data centers.
summary.zh: 总部位于圣地亚哥、成立于2024年的AI分析初创公司Atrium，推出了名为“Who Finances America's Data Centers”的互动数据与研究平台。该平台追踪美国每一笔数据中心交易背后的债务，覆盖近4,300个美国数据中心、共计1.3万亿美元可识别债务。

headline.en: Northleaf asset-based specialty finance fund closes at $450m
headline.zh: Northleaf 资产支持专项金融基金最终关闭，募集 4.5 亿美元

summary.en: Northleaf Capital Partners raised approximately $450m for its inaugural low-correlation asset-based specialty finance fund at final close. The amount includes commitments to the fund and co-investment vehicles investing alongside it.
summary.zh: Northleaf Capital Partners 为其首只低相关性资产支持专项金融基金完成最终关闭，募集约 4.5 亿美元。该金额包括对该基金及与其共同投资的投资工具的承诺出资。

headline.en: BasePoint Group files 13D reporting 26.8% stake in Katapult Holdings
headline.zh: BasePoint Group 提交 13D 文件，报告持有 Katapult Holdings 26.8% 股份

summary.en: BasePoint Group Inc. filed a Schedule 13D reporting beneficial ownership of 23,414,790 shares of Katapult Holdings, Inc. common stock, equal to 26.8% of the class. The percentage is based on approximately 87,400,000 shares of common stock outstanding, as reported on Katapult's 8-K filed with the SEC on August 11, 2026. The filing date is August 18, 2026.
summary.zh: BasePoint Group Inc. 提交 Schedule 13D，报告实益持有 Katapult Holdings, Inc. 普通股 23,414,790 股，占该类股份的 26.8%。该比例基于 Katapult 于 2026 年 8 月 11 日向 SEC 提交的 8-K 中所报告的约 87,400,000 股流通普通股计算。文件提交日期为 2026 年 8 月 18 日。

headline.en: Ninety One closes Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 at $404m
headline.zh: Ninety One 旗下 Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 最终募集 4.04 亿美元

summary.en: Ninety One announced the final close of its Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 with commitments totalling $404m from institutional investors. Commitments came from development finance institutions, pension funds and family offices across Africa, Europe and beyond.
summary.zh: Ninety One 宣布其 Africa Credit Opportunities Fund 3 完成最终关闭，募集承诺总额为 4.04 亿美元，来自机构投资者。出资方包括非洲、欧洲等地的开发性金融机构、养老基金和家族办公室。
